title: Current and Landfall
author: B. M. Nakamura
blurb: Casper Nakamura, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, has spent three years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
